description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various categories, with 14 slices in total. The largest slice is labeled "AI/NLP" and is colored blue, occupying approximately 24.3% of the chart. The second-largest slice is colored teal and accounts for around 20% of the chart, although its label is not fully visible. Other notable slices include "Game&Anim" (orange, 8.2%), "Law" (red, 8.2%), "History" (yellow, 6.7%), "Daily Life" (light green, 7.1%), "Med & Health" (pink, 5.5%), "Business" (dark orange, 5.9%), "Science" (light yellow, 5.1%), "Pet & Animal" (brown, partially obscured), "Geography" (red, 2.7%), and "Math" (yellow-green, 1.2%). The chart includes percentage labels outside the slices, connected by lines to their corresponding categories, and some labels are partially obscured. The slices appear to be arranged in a rough descending order of size, with the largest slices at the top and the smaller ones towards the bottom.
